type_cycle_reason: No import cycles, including type-only dependencies. Shared shapes belong in types modules, configuration belongs in config modules, and capability guards and routing containers must not import concrete runtime implementations. Cancellation primitives sit below their I/O and workspace consumers. Any new cycle fails the gate.

edges.typescript/packages/core/src/core/awk/bu: TypeScript awk reuses the shell printf's number formatters; Python's awk formats with Python's own. Moving the formatters below core is a cleanup of its own.
edges.typescript/packages/core/src/core/awk/va: TypeScript awk reuses the shell printf's number formatters; Python's awk formats with Python's own. Moving the formatters below core is a cleanup of its own.
edges.typescript/packages/core/src/vfs/base.ts: A VFS carries its bespoke commands (the public `commands` option) typed as Command, a type-only import; Python types the list as callables. S15 reshapes Command into the invocation commands and CLIs share.
edges.typescript/packages/node/src/cache/file/: node's redis file cache registers its factory in core's cache registry, since core cannot import node; Python's registry imports the redis cache directly.
